package.name: gz_bridge_helper
package.description: Qt6 tool that reads a URDF (and optional YAML files), suggests the Gazebo sensors and drive systems it needs, and writes a ROS 2 package with a ros_gz_bridge configuration, a world and a launch file so the model can be loaded into Gazebo Harmonic with the right topics bridged. It can also build, launch and check that every bridged topic carries messages.
